Text: "expanded leaves; they are only usable from emulation-group epochs onward in

Problem: Using a future VirtualClientOperationType is conditioned on all emulator clients deriving it, but no capability or GroupContext data signals when that holds. A sender cannot know whether peers can reproduce its LeafNode.

Suggested fix: Tie new operation types to an emulation-group capability or GroupContext field that changes only by Commit, or state that the set is fixed for this version.
